presenceNote: This story is about a site, not a mapped area: nothing is drawn. The Kentucky Archaeological Survey places the Indian Fort Mountain enclosure in the Middle Woodland period, with a calibrated date of about 39 BC to AD 236, and says it is Late Adena though it may not be related to Adena. Hopewell is an archaeological culture centred in Ohio; no source used here gives a Kentucky area for it, so only the story's pin is shown. Archaeological culture defined by artifacts and sites, not a tribe; no descent claim is made.
